onboarding.inviter_desc:
Hey **{user}**, thanks for inviting me.
Everything is ready to run. Here is what is left for you to do.
onboarding.step1_value:
Type `/setup` in the server (admin required).
You will pick the 4 channels: **Welcome**, **Logs**, **Alerts**, **Admin/Mods**.
Without it, some features do not know where to post.
onboarding.step2_value: [Open {dashboard_label}]({dashboard_url}) to adjust XP, the welcome message, features, moderator permissions, custom commands, Twitch/YouTube/Reddit alerts, and more.
onboarding.step3_value: `/commandes` for the full list, `/duel info` for PvP duels, `/play` for music, `/niveau` for your XP.
onboarding.tip_value: The **XP system** is **enabled by default**. To turn it off: `/xp off` or from the dashboard (XP already earned is kept).
onboarding.owner_desc:
Hey **{user}**, TookBot is now on **{guild}**.
Only one action is required from you as the owner:
onboarding.owner_warn_name: ⚠️ By default, moderators have access to everything
onboarding.owner_warn_value:
Until you configure their rights feature by feature:
• they cannot **use any moderation command**
• they cannot **open any dashboard page** (except their own Premium/Pass)
onboarding.owner_how_value:
**Dashboard**: open [{dashboard_label}]({dashboard_url}) and a popup guides you on the first login.
**Discord**: `/setup` to pick the moderator role, then a temporary private channel lets you tick the rights.
onboarding.owner_footer: You can change these rights at any time

guildboost.title: 🛡️ Guild Boost + activated on this server
guildboost.description:
{mention} just activated **Guild Boost +** on this server. The following features are now **unlocked**:

**⚙️ Custom commands** — direct `/<name>` commands
Create them from the dashboard: `dashboard.tookbot.click/custom-commands`

**🔔 Twitch / YouTube / Reddit alerts**
Set up per-channel alerts with: `/socialalert add`
Default channel: the one configured through `/setup` (Alerts).

**🎟️ Ticket system**
Create a ticket panel with: `/ticket`
Full management: claim, transcripts, dedicated modlog.

**📜 Extended logs**
Browse the server history on the dashboard: `dashboard.tookbot.click/logs`

💡 *To manage or disable a feature: `dashboard.tookbot.click/features`*
guildboost.footer: Guild Boost + — Thanks for supporting TookBot!
